mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eir_order (eir_no, business_type, container_no, container_size, container_type, company_id, status, remark, apply_by, apply_time, review_status, review_by, review_time, reject_reason) VALUES (#{eirNo}, #{businessType}, #{containerNo}, #{containerSize}, #{containerType}, #{companyId}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{applyBy}, #{applyTime}, #{reviewStatus}, #{reviewBy}, #{reviewTime}, #{rejectReason})
mapper.update:
UPDATE eir_order
dispatch_time = NOW(), dispatch_time = NULL, dispatch_time = NULL,
dispatch_time = NULL, audit_time = NOW(),
status = #{status}, tractor_id = #{tractorId}, driver_id = #{driverId}, gate_in_time = #{gateInTime}, gate_out_time = #{gateOutTime},
review_status = #{reviewStatus}, review_by = #{reviewBy}, review_time = #{reviewTime}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, apply_by = #{applyBy}, apply_time = #{applyTime},
WHERE id = #{id}
AND status = #{expectedStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM eir_order WHERE tractor_id = #{tractorId} AND status = #{status} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT business_type AS bizType, COUNT(1) AS count FROM eir_order GROUP BY business_type

SELECT d.date, SUM(d.gateIn) AS gateIn, SUM(d.gateOut) AS gateOut FROM ( SELECT DATE(gate_in_time) AS date, 1 AS gateIn, 0 AS gateOut FROM eir_order WHERE gate_in_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE(gate_in_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} UNION ALL SELECT DATE(gate_out_time) AS date, 0 AS gateIn, 1 AS gateOut FROM eir_order WHERE gate_out_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE(gate_out_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) d GROUP BY d.date ORDER BY d.date
mapper.update:
UPDATE eir_order SET status = #{status}, apply_by = #{applyBy}, apply_time = NOW(), review_status = 'PENDING', review_by = NULL, review_time = NULL, reject_reason = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
AND status = #{expectedStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.eir_no, e.business_type, e.container_no, e.container_size, e.container_type, e.company_id, c.name AS companyName, e.status, e.remark, e.create_time, e.apply_by AS applyBy, ap.name AS applicantName, e.apply_time AS applyTime, e.review_status AS reviewStatus, e.review_by AS reviewBy, rv.name AS reviewerName, e.review_time AS reviewTime, e.reject_reason AS rejectReason FROM eir_order e LEFT JOIN transport_company c ON c.id = e.company_id LEFT JOIN sys_user ap ON ap.id = e.apply_by LEFT JOIN sys_user rv ON rv.id = e.review_by WHERE e.status = 'SUBMITTED' ORDER BY e.apply_time ASC, e.id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM eir_order WHERE status = 'SUBMITTED'

SELECT e.id, e.eir_no AS eirNo, e.business_type AS businessType, e.container_no AS containerNo, e.status, t.plate_no AS plateNo, CASE WHEN e.audit_time IS NOT NULL THEN 'AUDIT' WHEN e.gate_out_time IS NOT NULL THEN 'GATE_OUT' ELSE 'GATE_IN' END AS opType, COALESCE(e.audit_time, e.gate_out_time, e.gate_in_time) AS opTime FROM eir_order e LEFT JOIN tractor t ON t.id = e.tractor_id WHERE e.gate_in_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY opTime DESC LIMIT #{limit}
